meta.name: EusoTrip Multi-Modal App Splash — DARK
meta.description: 3.0s dark-mode animated splash. All four brand beats (Truck -> Rail -> Aerial Vessel -> Flame Logo) are time-compressed (sped up, none dropped) to fit Apple's <=3s animated-splash guideline. Pairs with EusoTrip_Splash_iOS_3s_1080x1920.mp4.

dimensions.note: Matches the original splash exactly (1080x1920). Use resizeAspectFill on taller 19.5:9 devices to fill edge-to-edge.

timing.policy: Play once. Dismiss at totalMs, OR as soon as app data is ready after minimumDisplayMs, whichever is later, but never past maximumDisplayMs.

speedMap.note: Each source shot is 5s/4s of native footage compressed into its on-screen beat. 'speedMultiplier' = how much faster than real-time it plays; 'setptsFactor' is the ffmpeg PTS multiplier used.

safeArea.note: Hero subjects and the logo stay inside this box, clearing the Dynamic Island (top) and home indicator (bottom).

ios.launchScreen: Set LaunchScreen.storyboard to a single full-screen UIImageView (contentMode = .scaleAspectFill, pinned to superview edges, NOT safe area) using EusoTrip_LaunchScreen_1080x1920. This is the instant system launch frame.
ios.splashPlayback: After launch, present a splash view controller that plays EusoTrip_Splash_iOS_3s_1080x1920.mp4 with AVPlayer + AVPlayerLayer (videoGravity = .resizeAspectFill, isMuted = true). Observe AVPlayerItem.didPlayToEndTime to dismiss.
ios.handoff: Dismiss at totalMs (3000) or when data is ready after minimumDisplayMs; keep the static launch image as the first paint to avoid a black flash.
